name: ServiceEZ – Sales and Clients Management
author: prappo

sections.description:
ServiceEZ – Advanced Service Order Form Builder for WordPress

Transform your WordPress site into a powerful service booking platform with ServiceEZ – the most comprehensive and flexible service order form builder designed for modern businesses.

🎯 Perfect Solution For:

  • Freelancers offering multiple services
  • Consulting firms
  • Digital agencies
  • Creative professionals
  • Health & wellness providers
  • Event planners
  • Technical service providers
  • Any business offering bookable services

🌟 Key Features

Intuitive Service Builder

  • Create unlimited service types and packages
  • Drag-and-drop form builder interface
  • Live preview while building
  • Grid or list layout options
  • Flexible pricing options (one-time or recurring)
  • Customizable add-ons for each service
  • Quantity selection for packages and add-ons

Professional Payment Processing

  • Seamless Stripe integration
  • Support for multiple currencies
  • Secure payment processing
  • Invoice generation
  • Pay-later option with invoice
  • Coupon code system
  • Annual billing with customizable discount

Modern User Experience

  • Responsive mobile-first design
  • Dark/light mode support
  • Multi-language support (10+ languages)
  • Step-by-step booking process
  • Real-time price calculations
  • Custom branding options
  • Flexible layout customization

Advanced Business Features

  • Client management system
  • Order tracking and history
  • Email notifications
  • Custom receipt generation
  • Detailed order summaries
  • Admin dashboard with analytics
  • Client chat system

Powerful Admin Controls

  • Comprehensive settings panel
  • Payment gateway configuration
  • Email template customization
  • User role management
  • Currency settings
  • Layout customization

💪 Why Choose ServiceEZ?

Solve Complex Service Booking Challenges

  • Handle multiple service types under one platform
  • Manage complex pricing structures
  • Offer flexible payment options
  • Streamline client communication
  • Automate order processing

Save Time and Resources

  • Quick service setup
  • Automated payment processing
  • Built-in client management
  • Instant receipt generation
  • Automated email notifications

Boost Your Revenue

  • Upsell with add-ons
  • Implement strategic pricing
  • Offer discount coupons
  • Enable annual billing options
  • Increase conversion with professional forms

Professional Client Experience

  • Clean, modern interface
  • Mobile-responsive design
  • Multiple language support
  • Secure payment processing
  • Professional receipts and invoices

It’s a complete service business management solution that grows with your business. Whether you’re a solo freelancer or running a large service company, ServiceEZ provides the tools you need to streamline your service booking process and grow your revenue.

Don’t let complex service management hold your business back. Get ServiceEZ today and transform how you sell and manage your services online!
